chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ya'qub ibn Yaqtin from Al-Abd al-Salih (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about voluntary prayer on Friday. He said, 'If you wish to offer voluntary prayer on Friday while not on a journey, you pray six rak'at in the morning, six rak'at before midday, two rak'at when the sun declines before the Friday prayer, and six rak'at after the Friday prayer.'
And it has been narrated that it is permissible for a person to pray them as he prays on other days, in their proper sequence.
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended voluntary prayers and their timings on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details a specific, multi-phase schedule for voluntary Friday prayers, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the day through structured devotion before and after the congregational prayer. It highlights the scholarly tradition of balancing rigid ritual timing with flexibility, allowing believers to perform these nafl prayers either in the prescribed sequence or grouped together, reflecting the Shia emphasis on both discipline and ease in worship.
